sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 七十年的太空探索。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最强的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅出的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝成立175周年，致力于帮助您了解世界，充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 现在订阅可享受特别优惠，请访问 nytimes.com/subscribe。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Rachel Abrams, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的瑞秋·艾布拉姆斯，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: After President Trump's announcement of a ceasefire between Israel and Iran, all sides are claiming victory.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普总统宣布以色列和伊朗停火后，各方都声称自己取得了胜利。

sentences.en: But perhaps no country has emerged as a bigger winner than Israel.
sentences.zh: 但也许没有哪个国家比以色列赢得更多。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Patrick Kingsley explains how Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu helped to steer events to this moment and what might come next if the ceasefire holds.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事帕特里克·金斯利将解释本雅明·内塔尼亚胡总理是如何引导局势走到这一步的，以及如果停火持续下去，接下来会发生什么。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, June 25th.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月25日，星期三。

sentences.en: So Patrick, early this morning, President Trump was furious that Iran and Israel had continued to attack each other
sentences.zh: 那么帕特里克，今天凌晨，特朗普总统对伊朗和以色列继续相互攻击感到愤怒，

sentences.en: in the hours before the ceasefire that Trump very proudly announced was supposed to take effect.
sentences.zh: 就在特朗普非常自豪地宣布停火生效前的几个小时里。

sentences.en: The president even said, they don't know what the blank they're doing, but he used a word that rhymes with schmuck.
sentences.zh: 总统甚至说，他们根本不知道自己在干什么，但他用了一个听起来像“笨蛋”（schmuck）的词。

sentences.en: And what he was really angry about, it seemed, was Israel.
sentences.zh: 而他真正愤怒的似乎是以色列。

sentences.en: Specifically, he did not want Israel to continue dropping more bombs.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，他不希望以色列继续投掷更多炸弹。

sentences.en: He basically said or demanded that they were going to turn their fighter jets around.
sentences.zh: 他基本上是说，或者说要求他们必须调转战斗机返航。

sentences.en: And so I think the question on everybody's mind right now is, will the ceasefire actually hold?
sentences.zh: 所以我认为大家现在最关心的问题是，停火真的能持续下去吗？

sentences.en: You never know with the ceasefire, particularly in its opening stages.
sentences.zh: 停火这种事你永远说不准，尤其是在刚开始的阶段。

sentences.en: These arrangements can always break down and they can sometimes result in short spasms of violence before returning to calm.
sentences.zh: 这些协议随时可能破裂，有时在恢复平静之前，还会引发短暂的暴力冲突。

sentences.en: But as we're talking on Tuesday night here in Jerusalem and 2 p.m.
sentences.zh: 但正如我们在耶路撒冷周二晚上，也就是你们那边下午2点时所谈到的，

sentences.en: Eastern time over where you are, it does seem to be holding.
sentences.zh: 停火似乎正在维持。

sentences.en: The Israeli military issued an announcement a short while ago in which they said life could return to normal in Israel.
sentences.zh: 以色列军方不久前发布了一份声明，称以色列的生活可以恢复正常。

sentences.en: And that's a sign that the Israeli security establishment no longer think that Iran is on the verge of firing missiles into Israeli civilian areas.
sentences.zh: 这表明以色列安全机构不再认为伊朗即将向以色列平民区发射导弹。

sentences.en: Can you tell us a little bit about how this deal came about?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我们这个协议是如何达成的吗？

sentences.en: Our colleague Maggie Haberman reported that even some of Trump's closest advisors were caught off guard by his announcement last night.
sentences.zh: 我们的同事玛吉·哈伯曼报道说，甚至连特朗普的一些亲密顾问都对昨晚的声明感到措手不及。

sentences.en: Well, everything happened in fast forward from roundabout Sunday morning onward.
sentences.zh: 嗯，从周日上午左右开始，一切都按下了快进键。

sentences.en: President Trump ordered U.S.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统下令美国

sentences.en: planes to bomb three key nuclear sites that Israel had not been able to destroy.
sentences.zh: 飞机轰炸了三个以色列无法摧毁的关键核设施。

sentences.en: Then on Monday, Iran essentially decided to de-escalate.
sentences.zh: 然后周一，伊朗基本上决定缓和局势。

sentences.en: Instead of firing lots of missiles at lots of different American air bases and interests across the Middle East, they fired simply at one U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们没有向中东各地的许多美国空军基地和利益目标发射大量导弹，而只是向卡塔尔的一个美国

sentences.en: military base in Qatar, which was seen as a kind of signal that Iran wanted to respond in a somewhat token way.
sentences.zh: 军事基地开火，这被视为一种信号，表明伊朗希望以某种象征性的方式进行回应。

sentences.en: And then President Trump suddenly announced that he had brokered a deal between Israel and Iran.
sentences.zh: 然后特朗普总统突然宣布，他促成了以色列和伊朗之间的协议。

sentences.en: The deal is a little bit murky.
sentences.zh: 这份协议有点模糊。

sentences.en: We're not quite sure how it came about, but we do know from other reporting by my colleague here, Adam Raskon,
sentences.zh: 我们不太确定它是如何达成的，但我们从我的同事亚当·拉斯孔的其他报道中得知，

sentences.en: that the leadership of Qatar was essential to communicating between Israel and Iran.
sentences.zh: 卡塔尔的领导层在以色列和伊朗之间的沟通中起到了至关重要的作用。

sentences.en: And within hours, the Iranians said that they were on board with this plan.
sentences.zh: 几个小时内，伊朗人就表示他们同意这个计划。

sentences.en: Israel was still silent, and both sides continued to strike each other.
sentences.zh: 以色列当时保持沉默，双方继续相互攻击。

sentences.en: But then, as the morning wore on, not much more than 12 hours after Iran had struck the American air base, the fighting seemed to subside.
sentences.zh: 但随着上午的推移，在伊朗袭击美国空军基地不到12小时后，战斗似乎平息了。

sentences.en: And by mid-morning, the Israeli government had announced that they too were party to this deal.
sentences.zh: 到上午中期，以色列政府宣布他们也加入了这项协议。

sentences.en: And barring another attack or two from either side, the ceasefire has since held.
sentences.zh: 除非双方再发生一两次袭击，否则停火协议此后一直有效。

sentences.en: And it's all happened in surprisingly quick time.
sentences.zh: 这一切发生得快得惊人。

sentences.en: We've gone from being in a situation on Saturday night where we were braced for the outbreak of a much broader conflict involved in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们从周六晚上那种准备迎接涉及美国的中东地区更大规模冲突爆发的情况，

sentences.en: across the Middle East, to a situation where the Israel-Iran war of 2025 has been contained to just 12 days.
sentences.zh: 转变为2025年的以伊战争仅持续了12天的情况。

sentences.en: Now, it was still very deadly.
sentences.zh: 当然，它仍然非常致命。

sentences.en: In Iran, more than 600 people were reported dead.
sentences.zh: 据报道，伊朗有600多人死亡。

sentences.en: In Israel, up to 30.
sentences.zh: 以色列有30人死亡。

sentences.en: But the bloodshed still came to an end much more quickly than some had feared.
sentences.zh: 但流血事件的结束比一些人担心的要快得多。

sentences.en: That 180-degree turn that you described really is just so stark.
sentences.zh: 你所描述的那种180度大转弯确实非常鲜明。

sentences.en: The fact that we went from the possibility of this wider war to a ceasefire in just a couple days, it does make me wonder about Israel in all of this.
sentences.zh: 我们从可能爆发更广泛战争到仅仅几天内就实现停火，这确实让我对以色列在这一切中的角色感到好奇。

sentences.en: Because they were the ones who were lobbying for U.S.
sentences.zh: 因为他们几个月来一直游说美国

sentences.en: involvement for months.
sentences.zh: 介入。

sentences.en: What have they gained in all of this?
sentences.zh: 他们从中得到了什么？

sentences.en: In truth, Israel is the biggest winner.
sentences.zh: 事实上，以色列是最大的赢家。

sentences.en: For years, Israel perceived Iran as the biggest threat to its long-term future.
sentences.zh: 多年来，以色列一直将伊朗视为其长期未来的最大威胁。

sentences.en: And Netanyahu had made it his life's goal to launch a military attack on Iran big enough to set back its military capabilities and its nuclear program,
sentences.zh: 内塔尼亚胡将对伊朗发动足以挫败其军事能力和核计划的军事打击作为他的人生目标，

sentences.en: and in particular, its missile program.
sentences.zh: 特别是其导弹计划。

sentences.en: Now, we've just seen an early report from several of our colleagues that an initial assessment by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们刚刚看到几位同事的初步报告，美国政府的初步评估称，

sentences.en: government says that the Israeli and American strikes may have only set back Iran's nuclear program by less than six months.
sentences.zh: 以色列和美国的打击可能只让伊朗的核计划推迟了不到六个月。

sentences.en: But nevertheless, Iran's program is in a worse state than it was two weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 但尽管如此，伊朗的计划状况确实比两周前更糟了。

sentences.en: So, clearly, some nuclear sites have been damaged.
sentences.zh: 所以，显然一些核设施已经受损。

sentences.en: Iran no longer seems to have the ability to fire huge barrages of ballistic missiles at Israel.
sentences.zh: 伊朗似乎不再有能力向以色列发射大规模弹道导弹齐射。

sentences.en: So, the optics of this remain that this is a big win for Israel, even if we're uncertain about the exact nature of the details of that win.
sentences.zh: 因此，从表面上看，这对以色列来说仍然是一场大胜，即使我们不确定这场胜利的具体细节。

sentences.en: And in particular, it's a big win for Netanyahu, who, if we remember, at the start of the war with Hamas back in October 2023, was facing political oblivion.
sentences.zh: 特别是，这对内塔尼亚胡来说是一场大胜，如果我们记得的话，在2023年10月与哈马斯的战争开始时，他正面临政治上的毁灭。

sentences.en: He was seen in Israel as a man who had presided over the worst military catastrophe in Israeli history.
sentences.zh: 他在以色列被视为一个主持了以色列历史上最严重军事灾难的人。

sentences.en: And yet, now, he can claim, following the Iran campaign, to be the architect of one of Israel's greatest military victories.
sentences.zh: 然而现在，在伊朗战役之后，他可以声称自己是以色列最伟大的军事胜利之一的缔造者。

sentences.en: So, how did Netanyahu, in fact, pull all of this off?
sentences.zh: 那么，内塔尼亚胡实际上是如何做到这一切的呢？

sentences.en: It's a combination of his long-held ambition, a sequence of unforeseen events, and then, as time went on, a series of decisions by both Netanyahu and his military leaders
sentences.zh: 这是他长期以来的野心、一系列不可预见的事件，以及随着时间的推移，内塔尼亚胡及其军事领导人做出的一系列决策的结合，

sentences.en: that allowed him to get to this point.
sentences.zh: 使他能够走到这一步。

sentences.en: The timeline arguably starts on October 7th, when Hamas, which is an ally of Iran,
sentences.zh: 时间线可以说始于10月7日，当时伊朗的盟友哈马斯

sentences.en: surprised Israel with the deadliest attack in Israel's history.
sentences.zh: 以以色列历史上最致命的袭击震惊了以色列。

sentences.en: And Netanyahu was at the helm on that day.
sentences.zh: 而内塔尼亚胡那天就在掌舵。

sentences.en: And that ruined his credentials in the eyes of many Israelis.
sentences.zh: 这毁掉了他在许多以色列人心中的信誉。

sentences.en: He and his party plummeted in the opinion polls, and he was at a kind of political nadir.
sentences.zh: 他和他的政党在民意调查中暴跌，他处于一种政治低谷。

sentences.en: Because people blamed him for this attack.
sentences.zh: 因为人们因为这次袭击而责怪他。

sentences.en: At least in part, he was blamed, along with the leaders of Israel's security establishment.
sentences.zh: 至少在某种程度上，他和以色列安全机构的领导人一起受到了指责。

sentences.en: And it seemed like this was close to the end of his political career.
sentences.zh: 看起来这几乎是他政治生涯的终点。

sentences.en: But then, as time goes on,
sentences.zh: 但随后，随着时间的推移，

sentences.en: the war against Hamas evolves into a slightly wider war against Hamas and its regional allies.
sentences.zh: 针对哈马斯的战争演变成了一场针对哈马斯及其地区盟友的稍微广泛一点的战争。

sentences.en: And that leads to a series of decisive confrontations in the second half of last year, 2024, that essentially allowed Israel,
sentences.zh: 这导致了去年（2024年）下半年的一系列决定性对抗，这些对抗基本上让以色列，

sentences.en: if not to entirely defeat Hamas's ally in Lebanon, Hezbollah, to assassinate its top leadership, severely weaken its military capabilities,
sentences.zh: 如果不是完全击败哈马斯在黎巴嫩的盟友真主党，也足以暗杀其最高领导层，严重削弱其军事能力，

sentences.en: and force it back from the Israeli border.
sentences.zh: 并将其从以色列边境逼退。

sentences.en: And that also had a knock-on effect in Syria.
sentences.zh: 这也对叙利亚产生了连锁反应。

sentences.en: It meant the Syrian government, which was a key ally of Iran,
sentences.zh: 这意味着作为伊朗关键盟友的叙利亚政府，

sentences.en: collapsed under pressure from rebel groups in Syria.
sentences.zh: 在叙利亚反政府武装的压力下崩溃了。

sentences.en: And it did so in part because Iran and Hezbollah could no longer come to its aid because they were substantially weakened by this growing conflict.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是伊朗和真主党因为这场不断扩大的冲突而受到严重削弱，无法再对其提供援助。

sentences.en: And that, in turn, sucked Israel and Iran into a more direct confrontation.
sentences.zh: 而这反过来又将以色列和伊朗卷入了更直接的对抗。

sentences.en: They had been fighting what we call a shadow war, where mostly they were attacking each other through secret and unannounced attacks,
sentences.zh: 他们一直在进行所谓的影子战争，主要是通过秘密和未公开的攻击相互攻击，

sentences.en: sometimes cyberattacks, sometimes assassinations.
sentences.zh: 有时是网络攻击，有时是暗杀。

sentences.en: And that all broke out into the open as a result of this war with Hamas developing into a more intense regional conflict throughout the course of 2024.
sentences.zh: 随着这场与哈马斯的战争在2024年全年演变成更激烈的地区冲突，这一切都公开化了。

sentences.en: And so we enter 2025 in a situation that Israelis, by and large, could not have imagined at the start of this war.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们进入2025年时所处的情况，是以色列人在战争开始时无法想象的。

sentences.en: Instead of being humiliated by Hamas, suddenly Israel was increasingly dominant.
sentences.zh: 以色列没有被哈马斯羞辱，反而越来越占据主导地位。

sentences.en: And that created what many Israeli leaders, including Netanyahu, thought was a window of opportunity in which Iran was historically weakened
sentences.zh: 这创造了许多以色列领导人（包括内塔尼亚胡）认为的机遇之窗，当时伊朗在历史上处于弱势，

sentences.en: and unable to likely rely on its network of regional proxies and allies to come to its rescue in the event of a massive Israeli attack.
sentences.zh: 并且在面临大规模以色列袭击时，不太可能依靠其地区代理人和盟友网络来救援。

sentences.en: And Netanyahu and the Israeli military leadership began planning for such a massive attack.
sentences.zh: 内塔尼亚胡和以色列军事领导层开始计划进行这样的大规模袭击。

sentences.en: Okay, Patrick, just to make sure I have this right, it sounds like this is a story of Israel having this ambition for a very long time to take out Iran and its allies.
sentences.zh: 好的，帕特里克，为了确保我理解正确，听起来这是一个关于以色列长期以来一直有野心消灭伊朗及其盟友的故事。

sentences.en: But it has not been in a position to do this because of this risk of a wider war that certainly the United States has been worried about.
sentences.zh: 但由于美国一直担心的更广泛战争的风险，它一直无法做到这一点。

sentences.en: But that risk of a wider war now does not look as great as it has been all these years because of all the different conditions that you described.
sentences.zh: 但由于你描述的所有不同条件，这种更广泛战争的风险现在看起来不像这些年来那么大了。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And if we want to add an extra factor into what made all this come together, it was the effect of October 7th on the Israeli psyche.
sentences.zh: 如果我们想在这一切促成因素中增加一个额外因素，那就是10月7日对以色列心理的影响。

sentences.en: To critics of Israel,
sentences.zh: 对于以色列的批评者来说，

sentences.en: October 7th was caused in part because Israel did not end its occupation of the West Bank or its blockade of Gaza, and there was an eruption in response to that.
sentences.zh: 10月7日的部分原因是以色列没有结束对西岸的占领或对加沙的封锁，从而引发了反抗。

sentences.en: For many Israelis, they've concluded the opposite, that October 7th happened because Israel allowed a threat, Hamas, to grow in strength along its borders,
sentences.zh: 而许多以色列人得出了相反的结论，认为10月7日的发生是因为以色列允许哈马斯这一威胁在其边境壮大，

sentences.en: and Israel did not do anything about it soon enough.
sentences.zh: 而以色列没有足够快地采取行动。

sentences.en: And so the lesson that many Israelis have learned from that is that they need to act preemptively and decisively in order to take out such a threat.
sentences.zh: 因此，许多以色列人从中吸取的教训是，他们需要先发制人、果断行动，以消除这种威胁。

sentences.en: And we've seen that, first of all, with Hamas in Gaza, but also with Hezbollah in Lebanon.
sentences.zh: 我们首先在加沙的哈马斯身上看到了这一点，在黎巴嫩的真主党身上也看到了这一点。

sentences.en: And now...
sentences.zh: 现在……

sentences.en: And now with Iran.
sentences.zh: 现在是伊朗。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what made all of this also come together was the arrival in the White House of President Trump, who, despite making contradictory statements over the last weeks and months,
sentences.zh: 促成这一切的还有特朗普总统入主白宫，尽管他在过去几周和几个月里发表了相互矛盾的声明，

sentences.en: has become a crucial partner in Netanyahu's and Israel's campaign in Iran over the last 12 days.
sentences.zh: 但他已成为内塔尼亚胡和以色列过去12天在伊朗战役中的关键伙伴。

sentences.en: And to be clear,
sentences.zh: 需要明确的是，

sentences.en: Trump's support in this war was never actually a given until literally the bombs were dropping.
sentences.zh: 特朗普在这场战争中的支持直到炸弹真正落下之前，从来都不是理所当然的。

sentences.en: Their relationship has blown hot and cold, but he set about, from very early on in Trump's presidency, even as Trump was signaling that he wanted to negotiate with Iran
sentences.zh: 他们的关系时好时坏，但从特朗普总统任期很早开始，即使特朗普发出信号说他想与伊朗谈判

sentences.en: in order to get Iran to limit its nuclear ambitions.
sentences.zh: 以限制伊朗的核野心，

sentences.en: Netanyahu was trying to get Trump to back his military ambitions against Iran and back his vision of destroying
sentences.zh: 内塔尼亚胡就一直试图让特朗普支持他对伊朗的军事野心，并支持他摧毁

sentences.en: Iran's nuclear program, not through diplomacy, but by military force.
sentences.zh: 伊朗核计划的愿景，不是通过外交，而是通过军事力量。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。
